pond_lab.reset_scope: Deletes saved koi appearance, activity profiles and roster cache, then restarts the pond. Tuning is preserved.

workbench.title: Pond research lab
workbench.scene_hint: Choose the input and scene, then observe changes under the same conditions.
workbench.water_hint: Toggle or isolate effects to compare how water and lighting contribute to the image.
workbench.koi_hint: Choose a swim model and adjust its feel. Detailed physics and shape values are under Precision controls.
workbench.inspect_hint: Check runtime status and reset settings or stored caches when needed.
workbench.synthetic_note: Synthetic input is isolated from real usage. Keep the same roster while comparing changes.
workbench.live_note: Uses actual dashboard input. The roster and state can change over time.
workbench.effects_note: Checks reflect effect settings after parent gates. Isolate enables one effect with its required parent effects.
workbench.recipe_note: These feel sliders change several physics values together. Using them after precision adjustments recalculates the related physics values.
workbench.runtime_note: This is actual renderer readiness, including its first-frame acknowledgement. It is not an acknowledgement for each effect or a performance measurement.
workbench.reset_tuning_note: Restores environment and koi values. Reset visual styles and effect switches in their own sections.
workbench.scanner_unavailable: The pond renderer is unavailable for this theme.
workbench.tuner_unavailable: Detailed tuning is unavailable for this theme.

stats_pipeline_diagnostics.title: Usage tracking diagnostics
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.desc: Captures the active tab classifier, collection policy, alarms, durable facts, and dashboard read models without writing data.
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.copy_empty: No diagnostics report is available to copy.

stats_pipeline_diagnostics.stage_sequence_desc: Shows where the canonical path breaks, from browser source through dashboard snapshots.
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.boundary_desc: Compares runtime, hourly ledger, repository read, facts summary, and read model values.
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.target_matrix_desc: Compares raw ledger, repository series, activity-day, and Rules projection values per domain.
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.target_empty: No target domain is available. Enter one or keep a web tab active, then run again.
stats_pipeline_diagnostics.observations_desc: Fail/watch signals to inspect alongside the stage verdict.

sentinel_lab.debug_desc: Unlocks laboratory controls without console flags.
sentinel_lab.hud_visible_desc: Includes runtime HUD telemetry in debug launches.
sentinel_lab.validation_copy_hint: Run validation, then copy this report for the agent.
sentinel_lab.validation_frame_success_worker_blocked: Frame host rendered; page worker remains blocked.
sentinel_lab.render_no_trace: No spawn has been traced yet.
sentinel_lab.render_root_idle: Run Spawn to trace target selection through render acknowledgement.
sentinel_lab.render_root_pending: The request is in flight. Waiting for content readiness or render response.
sentinel_lab.render_root_api_unavailable: Chrome tab APIs are unavailable, so the target tab could not be inspected.
sentinel_lab.render_root_no_target: No target web tab was found. Activate x.com or select a tab directly.
sentinel_lab.render_root_invalid_target: The selected tab disappeared or is not a web page.
sentinel_lab.render_root_dispatch_ready_timeout: The content receiver did not report receiver_ready before the timeout. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_bootstrap_message_invalid: A bootstrap message reached the background without a valid status. The receiver state cannot advance.
sentinel_lab.render_root_bootstrap_stalled: The content runtime reported bootstrapping, then never advanced to receiver_ready.
sentinel_lab.render_root_bootstrap_signal_ignored: The content runtime reported receiver_ready/active, but the background session guard kept the tab in injecting.
sentinel_lab.render_root_loader_no_bootstrap: The loader was injected, but no bootstrap state reached the background.
sentinel_lab.render_root_missing_scripting: The scripting permission is missing, so the content script cannot be injected.
sentinel_lab.render_root_content_not_ready: The content runtime is not ready. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_send_failed: Message delivery failed after content readiness. Suspect navigation or receiver teardown.
sentinel_lab.render_root_rendered: Rendering was confirmed. The protocol reached the on-page runtime.
sentinel_lab.render_root_runtime_start_exception: The runtime threw while starting. Check renderer initialization and canvas ownership transfer. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_timeout: The spawn request was delivered, but no rendered acknowledgement arrived before timeout. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_worker_spawn_accepted_timeou: The worker accepted the spawn request, but did not report a rendered frame afterward. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_worker_spawn_requested_timeo: The spawn request was sent to the worker, but no accepted/rendered signal returned. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_canvas_missing: The spawn request reached the main runtime, but the canvas context was unavailable. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_live_limit: The spawn request reached the runtime, but the live entity cap is already full. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_total_limit: The spawn request reached the runtime, but the total spawn budget is already exhausted. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_worker_script_origin_blocked: The worker runtime was selected, but the page origin cannot open the extension worker script directly. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_worker_bootstrap_failed: The worker runtime bootstrap failed. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_runtime_inactive: The spawn request reached the runtime, but the runtime was not active. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_worker_runtime_failed: The worker runtime failed on the render path. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_split_limit: The spawn request reached the runtime, but split spawning is blocked by the current split limits. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_spawn_rejected: The runtime rejected the spawn request. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_render_failed: The spawn response did not finish as rendered. Code: {{code}}
sentinel_lab.render_root_delivered: The request reached the content runtime.

blossom_lab.preview_desc: Tune the flower separately. Apply changes the bonsai.
blossom_lab.controls_desc: These controls bias the blossom generator itself rather than faking a one-off render.
blossom_lab.apply_hint: Apply stores the tuning for future bonsai renders.
blossom_lab.toast_applied: Blossom tuning applied to the bonsai.

preview_yaw.label: Facing Yaw
preview_yaw.hint: Turn the blossom left or right to inspect side profile quality.

preview_pitch.label: Facing Pitch
preview_pitch.hint: Tilt the blossom upward or downward to inspect depth cues.

openness_bias.label: Openness Bias
openness_bias.hint: Push petals outward or keep them more closed.

petal_length_scale.label: Petal Length
petal_length_scale.hint: Lengthens or shortens the blossom silhouette.

petal_width_scale.label: Petal Width
petal_width_scale.hint: Controls whether petals feel slim or broad.

petal_count.label: Petal Count
petal_count.hint: Sets how many visible petals each flower presents.

layers.label: Layers
layers.hint: Adds inner petal rings for a fuller blossom.

ruffle_gain.label: Ruffle
ruffle_gain.hint: Amplifies petal waviness and edge softness.

core_size_gain.label: Core Size
core_size_gain.hint: Expands or compresses the pink center mass.

inner_scale_gain.label: Inner Scale
inner_scale_gain.hint: Adjusts inner petal spread and layering depth.

notch_depth_gain.label: Notch Depth
notch_depth_gain.hint: Changes how deeply each petal cleaves at the tip.

translucency_gain.label: Translucency
translucency_gain.hint: Controls light bleed through the petals.

stamen_burst_gain.label: Stamen Burst
stamen_burst_gain.hint: Makes the center stamens quieter or more radiant.

warmth_bias.label: Warmth Bias
warmth_bias.hint: Shifts the blossom toward cooler blush or warmer pink.
